brand_identity.name: Fastlane
brand_identity.tagline: Create, launch and scale winning ads with AI
brand_identity.description: Fastlane is an AI marketing agent for brands. Its agent, Senna, learns a brand from a URL, studies competitors and customers, creates ads and organic content, launches across Meta, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, and scales what works.

business_positioning.category: AI marketing agent / AI UGC content engine
business_positioning.market_position: Positions itself as an end-to-end autonomous marketing agent for solopreneurs and fast-growing teams, contrasted against AI ad generators, agencies, UGC marketplaces and general LLMs.
business_positioning.positioning_statement: The AI marketing agent that turns a product link into high-volume, trend-native short-form content, publishes it natively across four platforms, and scales the winners.

offerings.name: Fastlane
offerings.description: AI marketing agent platform (agent named Senna) that learns a brand from a URL, creates ads and organic content, publishes natively across social platforms, and optimizes based on performance.

decision_criteria: Native publishing to key platforms and attribution

offerings.name: Warmed accounts
offerings.description: Real US & EU TikTok and Instagram accounts created from scratch, warmed up in your niche and managed inside Fastlane, available as an add-on marketplace.

pain_points: New accounts get throttled before content reaches buyers.

buying_triggers: Just deployed a new app or feature

pain_points: $500+ per creator video and slow delivery
relatable_situations: Sample arrives after the trend is over

pain_points: Content volume is unmanageable by hand: building is fast but marketing by hand happens late and badly.
desired_outcomes: Only spend ad budget on creative with organic proof.
emotional_triggers: A single breakout video changing the trajectory of a launch.

example_phrases: Ship 30 days of viral content in 30 seconds

content_pillars: Volume-as-strategy: posting frequency and multi-format testing to beat creative fatigue.
creative_angles: Show the same product through many different AI character faces to imply adoption rather than advertising.
cultural_contexts: Tentative: AI-generated creator content is normalized in retail/social feeds but still openly debated for authenticity.
